section: SCCS/1636/21 Opinion on Butylated Hydroxytoluene (BHT), Conclusion p. 26
hazard: The SCCS assessed BHT in light of concerns regarding its potential endocrine-disrupting properties. Environmental safety was not assessed because environmental aspects fall outside the SCCS mandate.
opinion: The SCCS considers BHT safe for use in mouthwash at concentrations up to 0.001%, in toothpaste up to 0.1%, and in other leave-on and rinse-off cosmetic products up to 0.8%. BHT is also considered safe when these product categories are used in combination at their respective maximum concentrations. The assessment does not cover environmental safety.
conditions: BHT is considered safe up to 0.001% in mouthwash, 0.1% in toothpaste, and 0.8% in other leave-on and rinse-off products, including combined use at these concentrations.
source_quote: BHT is also considered safe for a combined use of mouthwash at a concentration of 0.001%, toothpaste at a concentration of 0.1% and other leave-on and rinse-off products at the concentration of 0.8%.
